name: Hakuouki Shinkai: Man'you no Shou
original_name: 薄桜鬼 真改 万葉ノ抄
source:
A fan disk that brings together a number of spin-off stories and illustrations into one, focusing on stories that were not included in the main story, such as recollections of incidents in "Hakuouki Zuisouroku".

[From [url=https://www.4gamer.net/games/683/G068365/20230203058/]4gamer.net (JP)[/url]]
translation:
一张将许多衍生故事和插图合二为一的同人光盘，重点关注主要故事中未包含的故事，例如《薄樱鬼醉色录》中的事件回忆。

[来自[url=https://www.4gamer.net/games/683/G068365/20230203058/]4gamer.net（日本）[/url]]
